text:
Creating the Analytic Variables


Code
df_analysis <- df %>%
  mutate(Race = race,
         `College Educated` = education_binary,
         Income = factor(case_when(What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "100-150-k" ~ "$100-150K",
                                   What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "under-20-k" ~ "Under $20K",
                                   What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "20-40-k" |
                                     What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "40-60k" ~ "$20-60K",
                                   What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "60-80-k" |
                                     What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "80-100-k" ~ "$60-100K",
                                   What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "150-200-k" |
                                     What.is.the.total.annual.income.of.your.household.before.taxes. == "over-200-k" ~ "Over $150K",
                                   TRUE ~ NA), 
                         levels = c("Under $20K", "$20-60K", "$60-100K", "$100-150K", "Over $150K")),
         `Party Affiliation` = case_when(Party == "democrat" ~ "Democrat",
                                         Party == "republican" ~ "Republican",
                                         TRUE ~ "Independent or Something Else"),
         Residence = factor(case_when(Area == "city" ~ "City",
                                      Area == "in-a-rural-area" ~ "Rural",
                                      Area == "small-town-next-to-native-community-e-g-reservation" |
                                        Area == "small-town-not-next-to-native-community-e-g-reservation" ~ "Small Town",
                                      TRUE ~ "Another location"),
                            levels = c("City", "Small Town", "Rural", "Another Location")),
         Region = case_when(Region..Midwest == T ~ "Midwest",
                            Region..Northeast == T ~ "Northeast",
                            Region..South == T ~ "South",
                            Region..West == T ~ "West"),
         Religion = factor(case_when(What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "atheist" ~ "Atheist",
                                             What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "catholic" ~ "Catholic",
                                             What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "evangelical-protestant" ~ "Evangelical Protestant",
                                             What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "mormon" ~ "Mormon",
                                             What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "muslim" ~ "Muslim",
                                             What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "other-protestant" ~ "Other Protestant",
                                             What.is.your.present.religion..if.any. == "nothing-in-particular" ~ "Not Religious",
                                             TRUE ~ "Other Religion"),
                           levels = c("Not Religious", "Atheist", "Catholic", "Evangelical Protestant", "Other Protestant", "Muslim",  "Other Religion")),
         `Religious Affiliation` = ifelse(Religion == "Not Religious", "Not Religious", "Religious"),
         Enrollment = enrollment_status,
         `Hawaiian Homes Beneficiary` = case_when(Are.you.a.beneficiary.of.the.Hawaiian.Homes.Commission.Act.of.1920..as.amended. == "yes" ~ "Yes",
                                                  Are.you.a.beneficiary.of.the.Hawaiian.Homes.Commission.Act.of.1920..as.amended. == "no" ~ "No",
                                                  Are.you.a.beneficiary.of.the.Hawaiian.Homes.Commission.Act.of.1920..as.amended. == "unsure" ~ "Unsure",
                                                  TRUE ~ NA),
         Residence = case_when(Area == "alaska-native-village" ~ "Alaska Native Village",
                               Area == "city" ~ "City",
                               Area == "hawaiian-homestead-through-department-of-hawaiian-home-lands" ~ "Hawaiian Homestead",
                               Area == "in-a-rural-area" ~ "Rural",
                               Area == "otsa-oklahoma-tribal-statistical-area" ~ "Oklahoma Tribal Statistical Area",
                               Area == "pueblo" ~ "Pueblo",
                               Area == "rancheria" ~ "Rancheria",
                               Area == "small-town-next-to-native-community-e-g-reservation" ~ "Small Town By Native Community",
                               Area == "small-town-not-next-to-native-community-e-g-reservation" ~ "Small Town Not By Native Community",
                               Area == "tribal-reservation" ~ "Tribal Reservation"),
         `Provided Tribal Affiliation` = tribal.affiliation.reported,
         Identity = case_when(Ethnicity..Alaska.Native == T & Ethnicity..American.Indian.Native.American == F & Ethnicity..First.Nations..Inuit.or.Metis == F & Ethnicity..Native.Hawaiian.Kanaka.Maoli == F & Ethnicity..Another.Native..ethnic..or.racial.group.not.identified.here == F ~ "Alaska Native",
                              Ethnicity..American.Indian.Native.American == T & Ethnicity..Alaska.Native == F & Ethnicity..First.Nations..Inuit.or.Metis == F & Ethnicity..Native.Hawaiian.Kanaka.Maoli == F & Ethnicity..Another.Native..ethnic..or.racial.group.not.identified.here == F  ~ "American Indian, Native American",
                              Ethnicity..First.Nations..Inuit.or.Metis == T & Ethnicity..American.Indian.Native.American == F & Ethnicity..Alaska.Native == F & Ethnicity..Native.Hawaiian.Kanaka.Maoli == F & Ethnicity..Another.Native..ethnic..or.racial.group.not.identified.here == F ~ "First Nations, Inuit, Metis",
                              Ethnicity..Native.Hawaiian.Kanaka.Maoli == T & Ethnicity..First.Nations..Inuit.or.Metis == F & Ethnicity..American.Indian.Native.American == F & Ethnicity..Alaska.Native == F & Ethnicity..Another.Native..ethnic..or.racial.group.not.identified.here == F ~ "Native Hawaiian, Kanaka Maoli",
                              TRUE ~ "Other or Multiple Indigenous Identities")) %>%
  select(Age, Gender, Race, `College Educated`, Income, `Party Affiliation`, Residence, Region, `Religious Affiliation`, 
         Identity, Enrollment, Residence, `Provided Tribal Affiliation`, `Hawaiian Homes Beneficiary`, summarized_party, 
         rep_baseline_categorical, landback_baseline_categorical, age_groups, Land.Back.Support, treatment, 
         video_perception, Reparations.Support, Feasibility.Land.Back, Feasibility.Reparations)

Table 3. Support for Reparations and Land Back Movements by Race and Political Affiliation

Support for Land Back


Code
df_analysis %>%
  select(Race, summarized_party, landback_baseline_categorical) %>% 
  mutate(`Identity Group` = Race,
         `Political Affiliation` = summarized_party) %>% 
  group_by(`Identity Group`, `Political Affiliation`) %>% 
  count(landback_baseline_categorical) %>%
  mutate(`Sample Size` = n,
         `Support (%)` = round(n/sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>% 
  filter(landback_baseline_categorical == "Support") %>% 
  select(`Identity Group`,`Political Affiliation`,`Sample Size`,`Support (%)`)



  





Support for Reparations


Code

  select(Race, summarized_party, rep_baseline_categorical) %>%

         `Political Affiliation` = summarized_party) %>% 
  group_by(`Identity Group`, `Political Affiliation`) %>% 
  count(rep_baseline_categorical) %>%
  mutate(`Sample Size` = n,
         `Support (%)` = round(n/sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>% 
  filter(rep_baseline_categorical == "Support") %>% 
  select(`Identity Group`,`Political Affiliation`,`Sample Size`,`Support (%)`)

section: Figure 1. Baseline Support for Reparations and Landback by Race
text:
Figure 1. Baseline Support for Reparations and Landback by Race


Code
# Create summary dataframe for Reparations baseline
df_rep_support <- df_analysis %>% 
  group_by(Race) %>% 
  count(rep_baseline_categorical) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = n/sum(n) * 100) %>% 
  rename(baseline_support = rep_baseline_categorical) %>% 
  add_column(Movement = "Reparations")

# Create summary dataframe for Land Back baseline
df_lb_support <- df_analysis %>% 
  group_by(Race) %>% 
  count(landback_baseline_categorical) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = n/sum(n) * 100) %>% 
  rename(baseline_support = landback_baseline_categorical) %>% 
  add_column(Movement = "Land Back")

# Merge summary dataframes for Reparations and Land Back
df_support <- bind_rows(df_rep_support, df_lb_support)

# Plot Figure 1
figure1 <- df_support %>% 
  mutate(Race = case_when(Race == "Black" ~ "Black Respondents",
                          Race == "Indigenous" ~ "Native Respondents"))  %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = baseline_support, y = Percentage, fill = Movement)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Baseline Support",
       y = "Percentage",
       fill = "Movement") +  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1DA595", "#F94B01")) + 
  facet_wrap(~Race) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Jost"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F2DC"),
        legend.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F8F2DC"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F2DC"),
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "#F8F2DC"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  add_column(Movement = "Reparations")

# Creating a summary dataframe of baseline Land Back support by political party

  group_by(Race, summarized_party) %>% 
  count(landback_baseline_categorical) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = n/sum(n) * 100) %>% 
  rename(baseline_support = landback_baseline_categorical) %>%

# Combining both Reparations and Land Back dataframes

# Regression model for Land Back support
df_model0_lb <- tidy(lm(Land.Back.Support ~ treatment + video_perception, df)) %>%

# Calculating movement support
df_figure7 <- df %>%
  mutate(support_reparations = ifelse(rep_baseline_categorical == "Support", 1, 0),
         support_landback = ifelse(landback_baseline_categorical == "Support", 1, 0),
         feasibility_landback = ifelse(Feasibility.Land.Back == "Yes", 1, 0),
         feasibility_reparations = ifelse(Feasibility.Reparations == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>% 
  filter((race == "Indigenous" & support_landback == 1) | (race == "Black" & support_reparations == 1)) %>%
  mutate(hope = case_when(race == "Indigenous" ~ feasibility_landback,
                          race == "Black" ~ feasibility_reparations)) %>%
  group_by(race) %>%
  count(hope) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = n/sum(n) * 100) %>%
  mutate(hope = ifelse(hope == 1, "Feasible", "Hope Gap")) %>%
  mutate(movement = "Own Movement",
         hope = factor(hope, levels = c("Hope Gap", "Feasible"))) 
  
# Plotting Figure 7
figure7 <- df_figure7 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = race, y = Percentage, fill = hope)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Identity",
       y = "Percentage",
       fill = "Feasibility") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
